name: Medal Tree
storyline:
"Medal Tree" is a desktop medal game that you can leave running idle. Over time, the tree bears medals, and when they ripen and change color, clicking the platform will cause the medals to pop out. They will also pop out automatically over time.

The popped medals are gathered by the helpful Ducklings, who assist in pushing them off the table. Use the medals you've collected to grow the Medal Tree or upgrade the Ducklings to collect medals more efficiently!
summary: Enjoy the medal pusher game on your desktop! For those of you who are busy, the Kamo characters will help carry the medals! Use the medals you've collected to earn even more!
